# Pixel Poll

A fully offline, accessible pixel poll web app with 4 options, vote counting, percentage bars, vote changing, and reset. Built with only HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

## Features

- 4 poll options
- Vote by clicking an option
- Vote count and percentage bar for each option
- Change your vote by clicking another option
- Reset votes button
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus indicators
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- Cohesive dark palette with smooth transitions

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network required.

## Technical Details

- No external dependencies, packages, or network requests
- No inline event handlers
- Uses `addEventListener` for all interactions
- ARIA labels and roles for screen readers
- CSS custom properties for theming
- System font stack at 16px minimum

## Files

- `index.html` — main HTML structure
- `styles.css` — styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` — poll logic and state management
- `README.md` — this file
